TextView.android:text: This application provides core telephony services converted to a reliable Java-based architecture. It is designed to handle basic phone functions efficiently.

• Dialing: Intuitive interface to input phone numbers and initiate calls via the system dialer.

• In-Call Management: Custom In-Call Service to manage active calls, including answering and hanging up.

• Call State Monitoring: Real-time tracking of call states (Ringing, Active, Holding, Disconnected).

• Call Logging Service: Background service prepared to log call events for history tracking.

• Call Recording: Built-in capability to record calls for later review (permissions required).

• Reliable Structure: Entirely written in Java using XML layouts for maximum compatibility and stability.
